newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine group wins order to build gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Argentine group wins order to build gas pipeline.

text.p: An Argentine consortium won on Monday a tender to build a gas pipeline in the eastern province of Entre Rios, the state news agency Telam said.

The group formed by SADE, Lemiro Pietroboni and Transportadora de Gas del Sur offered to build the 435 kilometer pipeline for $91 million or $103.5 million depending on whether the provincial government opts for 12 or 16 tubes.
Rival local group formed by industrial giant Techint and other companies offered $92.4 million and $106 million.
Construction should start this month and be completed in a year. The province of Entre Rios planned the pipeline to be eventually extended to sell gas to Uruguay and Brazil.
